native_controls.scope: Actual unchanged MergeKeyReducer/MergeValueReducer, real Hadoop0.20.2 Reducer.Context and writable deserializers; authored serialized input and recording writer/status adapters; no HDFS/shuffle/cluster
native_controls.confirmed: Single new record wins over old in both input orders for key/value reducers; two new records choose last, so reversing order changes selected payload
native_controls.rejected_hypothesis: Hadoop wrapper reuse did not overwrite a selected new payload with subsequent old payload in these4cases; successful HihoValue.readFields creates fresh nested value. No normal object-reuse corruption claimed.

source_only_findings.finding: setup uses splitPath.toString().contains(configured old path) before contains(new path), without component/URI boundary check; overlapping substrings may misclassify input; source-only, mapper runtime unexecuted

own_library_relevance: Retain deterministic selection and component-aware path identity; previously verified exact_files sibling-prefix regressions and collision safeguards remain evidence from their recorded runs, not new tests here
